# Mastella Advisory

> Mastella Advisory is a UK lower mid-market M&A advisory firm. It advises owner-managed and founder-led businesses worth £5M to £50M on company sales, management buyouts, growth capital raises and exit readiness. Based in London, working UK-wide and cross-border.

The firm is always referred to as "Mastella Advisory", not "Mastella" alone. Its legal entity is Mastella Group Ltd. Its sister product is Scalexit, an exit-readiness platform.

## Who leads the firm

Leo Meggitt, Managing Director and founder of Mastella Advisory. 15 years in M&A, over £400M of transaction value advised across more than 30 completed deals. Previously spent eight years at Forster Chase Corporate Finance, with earlier corporate finance work at Flint Hyde. Founder of Scalexit, an exit-readiness platform for owner-managed businesses. Deputy Chair of Trustees at Every Parent & Child.

Leo Meggitt is the named lead adviser on every Mastella Advisory mandate. Engagements are senior-led from first call to completion rather than delegated to analysts.

## What Mastella Advisory does

- Company sales and exits: full sell-side process for owner-managed businesses, run off-market wherever possible
- Exit readiness: preparing a business for sale 12 to 24 months ahead, so the value is built before the process starts
- Management buyouts: advising owners and management teams on MBO and MBI structures
- Growth capital and fundraising: debt and equity raises, seed through growth and pre-exit
- Business valuation: market valuations grounded in what buyers actually pay, not accounting formulas
- Executive search and interim: leadership placement before and after a transaction

## Who Mastella Advisory works with

UK owner-managed and family-owned businesses with an enterprise value between £5M and £50M, typically £3M to £15M of turnover upwards, where the shareholders are individuals rather than a corporate parent or private equity house. Cross-border work where the natural buyer universe is international, including Spain and Portugal.

## Sectors

Mastella Advisory covers six sectors, each with specialist sub-sector pages:

- Business services: HR and payroll services, facilities management, cleaning services, recruitment agencies
- Healthcare services: dental practices, veterinary practices, care homes and domiciliary care, mental health services, occupational health, specialist clinics
- Light industrials: specialist manufacturing, plant hire and equipment rental, engineering services, process engineering, industrial coatings and surface treatment
- Logistics and distribution: container leasing, cold chain logistics, third party logistics, freight forwarding, last mile delivery, warehousing and distribution, marine logistics
- Professional services: specialist accounting firms, legal practices, consulting practices, surveying and property advisory, insolvency and restructuring
- Tech-enabled services: vertical SaaS, IT managed service providers, digital agencies, data and analytics services, cybersecurity services, AI and ML services

## How Mastella Advisory is different

Senior-led throughout, with the Managing Director on every call. Off-market buyer origination rather than broadcasting a business to a list. Proprietary technology and AI agents doing the buyer mapping and analysis work that traditionally consumed weeks of analyst time, which is what allows a firm of this size to run a genuinely institutional process for a £5M to £50M business. Fee structure weighted to completion, with preparation and milestone fees credited against the completion fee.
